bumpRationale: Patch: weekly automated audit. No app code, entity schema, or RLS rule changed since the v1.7.0 audit (2026-07-13) or the metadata-only PR #151 (2026-07-20) — the only intervening commits were bot-driven dependency bumps (@base44/sdk 0.8.35→0.8.40, axios 1.18.0→1.18.1) and a build-config change (base44/.app.jsonc stopped being tracked; now managed via `base44 link`), already merged to main and re-verified here. This audit's own `npm ci` surfaced 6 new transitive-dependency advisories (introduced by upstream tooling releases, not by any Liuma change): dompurify (CUSTOM_ELEMENT_HANDLING bypass), js-yaml (quadratic-CPU DoS), and postcss/nanoid (sourcemap path traversal) were closed via `npm audit fix` (non-breaking patch bumps only) and re-verified against the full quality-gate suite. A residual brace-expansion (dev-only, eslint toolchain) advisory and a moderate react-router advisory (production dependency) remain — see docs/security-audit-2026-07-27.md for why both are accepted risk this round rather than force-fixed. No permission, tenant-isolation, student-data, or AI/RAG behavior changed. 271 tests pass; lint clean; typecheck clean; RLS validation green (32 entities); release gate green (23/23); build succeeds.

architecture.runtime: browser (client-side only; no application server) + Base44 backend functions for privileged mutations
architecture.enforcementBoundary: base44 Row-Level Security (entity + field-level RLS) in base44/entities/*.jsonc + service-role backend functions in base44/functions/*
architecture.language: JavaScript / JSX (type-checked via jsconfig); Deno TypeScript for backend functions

assistantSkills.note: The sibling claude-skills repo holds 48 generic Anthropic/Claude authoring skills (pdf, xlsx, brainstorming, math-olympiad, ...). They are assistant tooling used to BUILD Liuma — NOT features of the application, not integrated into it, and not listed in the user manual.
